title: Question 11
passage:
The dryer says it’s finished, but my towels are still damp.
A. That machine takes card payments. B. I folded mine at that table. C. Try a few more minutes on the low setting.
passageZh:
烘衣機顯示完成了，可是我的毛巾還是潮的。
A. 那台機器可以刷卡付費。
B. 我的衣物是在那張桌子上摺的。
C. 試著用低溫再烘幾分鐘。
